messages:
sophia: quick ask — need a short elevated window (30m) for kevin to run a read-only check against analytics-prod logs to confirm suspected PII leaking from embedder svc. ticket ENG-4820 linked. scope: read-only, no exports. @security PTAL :pray:
kevin: I can take this. will use ephemeral role, run a few selective queries. exact hosts?
kevin: example command i'll run:
```
psql -h analytics-prod.internal -U kevin_elev -d analytics -c "SELECT id, message FROM embed_logs WHERE message ~ 'ssn|dob|ccn' LIMIT 100;"
```
maria: approved for kevin for 30m. scope approved: logs.embed_logs only, no data dumps, and outputs must be redacted before sharing. i'll be on-call while this runs.
securitybot: please paste the ticket ENG-4820 justification here and confirm exact queries + target table/cluster. ephemeral access must be provisioned via Gatekeeper with audit enabled. also confirm manager approval (maria) — got it.
sophia: ENG-4820 justification: embedder svc started logging raw inputs after recent debug flag flip; need to confirm if any PII surfaced and redact pipeline coverage. target: analytics-prod/embed_logs table, columns: id, service, message, ts. queries limited to regex checks. will not copy results externally.
kevin: exact query i'll run (one-off):
```
-- check for SSN-like patterns
SELECT id, substring(message from '\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4}') AS ssn, ts
FROM embed_logs
WHERE message ~ '\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4}'
LIMIT 50;
```
kevin: also will run a tokenized check for DOB patterns and obvious cc numbers, then redact any matches before posting.
raj: reminder — if you find PII, create a privacy incident and tag privacy@redwood. do not paste raw PII into slack. use redaction tool or paste counts only. :warning:
gatekeeper-bot: created ephemeral session id s-8f3b2, role=ephemeral_admin, ttl=30m. start session: https://gatekeeper.internal/sessions/s-8f3b2
kevin: joining session now, running query. will share counts only.
kevin: result summary — found 3 rows with SSN-like patterns, 7 rows with DOB-like patterns. redacted outputs stored to ENG-4820 with reason and redaction notes. created PRIV-199 to track remediation.
kevin: commands i ran (sanitized):
```
-- counted matches
SELECT count(*) FROM embed_logs WHERE message ~ '\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4}';
SELECT count(*) FROM embed_logs WHERE message ~ '\b(19|20)\d{2}-\d{2}-\d{2} ';
```
maria: confirmed, good triage. thanks kevin and sophia. please follow up on PRIV-199 and schedule removal of debug logging flag asap.
gatekeeper-bot: session s-8f3b2 expired (30m TTL reached) and role ephemeral_admin revoked. audit log: https://audits.internal/sessions/s-8f3b2
sophia: thanks all — access removed and remediation ticket assigned. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
